title: 700亿收入刚宣布：口径一换少200亿，算力扩张还撑得住吗
speaker: Man Deep Singh

segments.en: Well, it is significant in the sense that OpenAI had a dev day on September 29th, and
segments.zh: 这件事之所以重要，是因为OpenAI在9月29日举办了开发者日，

segments.en: they mentioned, you know, the ARR was 70 billion, so it is a big deal that, you know, even
segments.zh: 当时他们提到年度经常性收入是700亿，所以即便

segments.en: if it's an accounting change in terms of, you know, showing net revenue versus gross revenue previously, why didn't they talk about it, you know, a week before?
segments.zh: 这只是从毛收入改为净收入的会计口径变化，为什么一周前没有说明？

segments.en: And I mean, to my mind, you know, if CapEx numbers are going up, which everyone thinks they are, you know, next year, it's going to be 1.2, 1.3 trillion in hyperscale plus Neocloud CapEx,
segments.zh: 在我看来，如果资本开支继续上升——大家都这么认为——明年超大规模加新型云的开支将达到1.2到1.3万亿，

segments.en: the revenue for these frontier labs has to scale with the CapEx because they are the ones who are at the forefront of showing ROI.
segments.zh: 这些前沿实验室的收入必须与资本开支同步增长，因为它们是展示回报率的最前沿。

segments.en: And if that doesn't scale up with CapEx, which it sounds like, you know, if it's a 20 billion shortfall, then I think there could be, you know, some anxiety around that.
segments.zh: 如果收入没有跟上资本开支——听起来有200亿的缺口——那市场就会有些焦虑。

segments.en: But if they were to revise these numbers, you know, the prior number before 70 billion was 40 billion.
segments.zh: 但如果他们要修正这些数字，700亿之前的数字是400亿。

segments.en: So how does that trajectory look like that to me is the most important thing, if everything is getting revised to net number, what does the prior numbers look like?
segments.zh: 所以这个增长轨迹才是最重要的，如果全部改为净收入口径，之前的数字又是什么样？

segments.en: And I think that will, you know, help resolve some of the anxiety around this 20 billion gap here.
segments.zh: 我认为这有助于缓解围绕这200亿缺口的焦虑。
